children.heading: Dollars
children.text: Except as provided in paragraph (2), agreements under this subchapter shall require that payment for agricultural commodities be made in dollars.

children.heading: In general
children.text: The Secretary may permit payment under an agreement under this subchapter in the local currency of the appropriate country in order to use the proceeds from such payments to carry out activities under section 1704 of this title.

children.heading: Rates of exchange
children.text: Payments in local currency shall be at rates of exchange that are no less favorable than the highest exchange rate legally obtainable in the country and that are no less favorable than the highest exchange rate obtainable by any other country.

tree.heading: Interest
tree.text: Such agreements shall provide that interest accrue on the payment deferred under such agreement at a concessional rate as determined appropriate by the Secretary.

tree.heading: Duration
tree.text: Payments required under such agreements may be made in reasonable annual amounts over the period (not more than 30 years from the date of the last delivery of commodities in each year under such agreement) specified in the agreement.

tree.heading: Deferral of payments
tree.text: The Secretary may defer the date on which the developing country or private entity is required to begin making payment, under such agreements, for a period of not in excess of 5 years after the date of the last delivery of commodities in each year under the agreement, and interest shall be computed from the date of such last delivery.

tree.heading: Delivery of commodities
tree.text: Delivery of the commodities shall be made in accordance with the terms of the agreement.
